---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 20.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0    # s for any one solve

opt = optimize_glider_unswept_c4(verbose=False)
mass = opt["mass"]

glider = make_glider_unswept_c4(opt["c_root"], opt["taper"], opt["cg_x"])
main_wing_area = glider.wings[0].area()

wing_loading_kg_m2 = mass / main_wing_area
wing_loading_g_dm2 = wing_loading_kg_m2 * 10
wing_loading_n_m2 = mass * 9.81 / main_wing_area
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{wing_loading_g_dm2:.2f}"`]{.hero-value}

:::
